answer: Each task is bound to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse unavailable at issuance. An agent commits to its response before the pulse and reveals it afterward; verification derives the instance from the pulse and the commitment. Because the entropy is unpredictable and publicly auditable, sybil identities cannot pre-compute winning work, farm solutions offline, or reuse one answer. Domain-separated labels—vertex, sparrow, vine—prevent cross-task reuse.
